name: Camping Edelweiss
beschreibung: The Camping Edelweiss is located in Neustift im Stubaital amid the Stubaier Alpen. The facility offers pitches for caravans, motorhomes and tents as well as apartments and huts for rent. A heated outdoor pool and a sauna are available for leisure activities. In summer, the site is a starting point for hikes and mountain bike tours in the Stubaital. In winter, paths lead to the ski areas Stubaier Glets
